name: edit
description: 通过精确字符串替换编辑文件。支持三种模式：单次替换（path+oldString+newString，向后兼容）、单文件批量（path+edits 数组，顺序应用，预校验全通过才原子写入）、多文件批量（files 数组，文件级独立原子：失败文件跳过，其余照常）。多级模糊容错（CRLF/tab/行尾空白）+ sha256 乐观锁（expectHash 防并发覆盖）+ dryRun 预览。强制 read-before-overwrite + 哈希备份 + diff 返回。
description_en: Edit files via exact string replacement. Three modes: single replacement (path+oldString+newString, backward compatible), single-file batch (path+edits array, applied in order, atomically written only after all pre-checks pass), multi-file batch (files array, per-file independent atomicity: failed files are skipped, the rest still apply). Multi-level fuzzy tolerance (CRLF/tab/trailing whitespace) + sha256 optimistic lock (expectHash prevents concurrent overwrites) + dryRun preview. Enforces read-before-overwrite + hash backup + diff in results.

path.description: 单文件路径（模式 A/B 用，与 files 互斥）
path.description_en: Single-file path (for modes A/B, mutually exclusive with files)

oldString.description: 模式 A：要在文件中查找的精确字符串
oldString.description_en: Mode A: exact string to find in the file

newString.description: 模式 A：用于替换 oldString 的字符串
newString.description_en: Mode A: string to replace oldString with

replaceAll.description: 模式 A：替换全部出现（默认 false，此时 oldString 必须唯一）
replaceAll.description_en: Mode A: replace all occurrences (default false; when false, oldString must be unique)

edits.description: 模式 B：单文件多编辑，顺序应用（edit[N] 在 edit[N-1] 修改后的内容上查找）。预校验全通过才原子写入一次，任一失败则整体不写入
edits.description_en: Mode B: multiple edits to one file, applied in order (edit[N] is searched against the content after edit[N-1]). Atomically written once only if all pre-checks pass; if any fails, nothing is written

replaceAll.description: 替换全部出现（默认 false）

files.description: 模式 C：多文件批量。文件级独立原子：每个文件独立预校验+原子写入，某文件失败只跳过该文件，其他成功的照常生效
files.description_en: Mode C: multi-file batch. Per-file independent atomicity: each file gets its own pre-check + atomic write; a failed file is skipped while other successful files still apply

edits.description: 该文件的多编辑（同 edits 结构）
edits.description_en: Multiple edits for this file (same structure as edits)

expectHash.description: sha256 乐观锁：来自最近一次 read 返回的 sha256。提供则校验，若文件已被外部修改（哈希不匹配）则拒绝写入并提示重新 read
expectHash.description_en: sha256 optimistic lock: the sha256 returned by the most recent read. If provided it is verified; if the file was modified externally (hash mismatch) the write is rejected with a prompt to re-read

dryRun.description: true=只返回 diff 预览不写入文件（默认 false）
dryRun.description_en: true=only return a diff preview without writing the file (default false)
